I work with Python, Java, FastAPI, Spring Boot, PyTorch, and React to turn complex data into practical systems, with a focus on model performance, reliability, and real-world problem-solving.

Also interested in data engineering, Python development, full-stack development, and software engineering, bringing programming expertise and problem-solving skills to efficient, scalable applications.

My foundation spans data analysis, statistical modeling, data visualization, full-stack development, and workflow automation, including RPA with UiPath. I completed practical full-stack training at Kodnest Technologies, Bangalore.

projects.title: Lenok TMS — Turnaround Management System
projects.description: Built a multi-camera AI pipeline to analyze aircraft and ground-support-equipment interactions in real time. Integrated PostgreSQL telemetry with a React dashboard for operational monitoring.
projects.technologies: Python, YOLOv8-Seg, ByteTrack, PyTorch, FastAPI, OpenCV, React, PostgreSQL
projects.problem: Understand aircraft and ground-support-equipment interactions across multiple camera streams.
projects.approach: Improved aircraft segmentation with custom mask processing and OpenCV morphology. Developed tracking and turnaround event logic using ByteTrack and finite-state machines.
projects.outcome: Real-time event analysis, PostgreSQL telemetry, and an operational monitoring dashboard.

projects.title: Lenok Airport CRM — AI Contract Extraction and Review
projects.description: Built an evaluation-ready CRM contract review application for scanned PDFs, native PDFs, and DOCX files using Azure Document Intelligence and Microsoft Foundry.
projects.technologies: Python, FastAPI, Azure Document Intelligence, Microsoft Foundry, JavaScript, Docker
projects.problem: Extract contract details with evidence that users can verify before creating a CRM record.
projects.approach: Added structured field extraction, page citations, evidence checks, and a review screen for users to correct results.
projects.outcome: A document-to-review workflow with traceable evidence and user correction before CRM record creation.

projects.title: Enterprise Vision Extraction Engine — Airport Utility OCR
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot service to extract meter readings, dates, and times from scratched and high-glare seven-segment LCD images.
projects.technologies: Java 21, Spring Boot, ONNX Runtime (RapidOCR), PostgreSQL, Spring Data JPA, REST APIs
projects.problem: Read utility meters from difficult images with broken LCD segments, scratches, and glare.
projects.approach: Used morphological dilation before ONNX OCR inference and deterministic regular expressions for parsing. Added Laplacian-variance and pixel-threshold quality checks, API-key filtering, and offline mobile synchronization support.
projects.outcome: Searchable verification metadata in PostgreSQL, with raw images archived on disk.

projects.title: SmartLog Occupancy
projects.description: Developed real-time entry/exit counting using YOLO, YOLO26-Pose ankle-keypoint detection, OCSort, polygon zones, and RTSP camera streams.
projects.technologies: Python, YOLO, YOLO26-Pose, OCSort, FastAPI, Docker, PostgreSQL, WebSockets
projects.problem: Count entry and exit events from live camera streams using pose-aware tracking and polygon zones.
projects.approach: Improved stream handling with multithreaded queues, frame dropping, FP16 inference, and dynamic resolution scaling.
projects.outcome: Live occupancy analytics exposed through FastAPI, WebSockets, and PostgreSQL.

projects.title: Airport Management RAG Chatbot
projects.description: Built a local RAG chatbot for searching airport operations and compliance documents.
projects.technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Spring AI, Ollama, PgVector
projects.problem: Search airport operations and compliance documentation through a conversational interface.
projects.approach: Combined semantic embeddings, vector storage, local LLM inference, and chat memory.
projects.outcome: A local retrieval-augmented chatbot for enterprise document search.
